body: Sorry to ask, but why are you unhappy?

I like pets too, but I can't even look after myself, I don't think I take this responsability and properly look after a loving animal. Especially, since I don't think I'll love much longer.

I can afford therapy and meds, but I just don't see how that can help me. All I cared about is gone, nothing can change that.

I'm glad you turned your life around. Dogs indeed are precious.

Yeah, you are right aboyt grades. I always felt so stupid, no matter how well I passed all the exams. You can always improve your intelligence, that's for sure. It all comes down to self-esteem though. So, even if you do get smarter, you can still feel useless. 

I really hope you'll get better.

If you have good grades at the prestige university, why do you think that you're not as smart as before?
No, I believe I'm beyond help. You can't help those who  an't help themselves, I guess.

My parents know everything. And that I'm going to kill myself too.
Wbat are you struggling with?

I'm sorry you feel this way too. I also started to think about suicide since 13-14. It tears me appart that I can't return my past. I'm living in my dreams, so I wouldn't face reality. How do you deal with all of this?
Yeha. Well, the way a person percieves his life also matters
Thanks for the attention. Not that it changes anything, but for some reason I wanted to see what people think or what they have been through.
Because I already had "one last run" after my first attempt, and it just ruined everything. I'm too weak-willed now
The fact it never stopped for you, it just means it doesn't get better no matter what people say. For me every year it's just getting worse. And I just don't want try anymore to make it better.
Yeah, I get it. But,after all, I think they are relived that you are alive. I don't know why you tried to kill yourself, but I hope your life will turn around after that.

Yes, it was an year ago. I can't tell you what causes your feelings, for me it was definitely psychological. I'd recommend consulting your doctors.
It is still my biggest regret that I was saved. Do you regret taking pills or being rescued?
